title: Maharashtra allows offline crop registration for farmers amid app glitches
description:
Around 70 lakh farmers in Maharashtra facing technical glitches with the Centre's Digital Crop Survey mobile app can now register their crops offline via the e-ferfar system, an official said on Saturday.
Following directions from Revenue Minister Chandrashekhar Bawankule, the state revenue department on Friday issued a Government Resolution (GR) permitting talathi-level crop inspections in places where online registration is pending for the ongoing Kharif season.
According to the GR, the state introduced the e-crop inspection system on August 15, 2021, enabling farmers to register crop details through their mobile phones. The process aims to make crop registration accessible and transparent.
The state government introduced technical changes in the application from December 1, 2024, to facilitate crop registration through the AgriStack platform.
